record.title: A legend cell chooses the boolean operation
record.written_solution: The top-left legend cell chooses the operation to apply to the two cropped source objects after top-left normalization: 1 → union, 2 → intersection, 3 → xor, 4 → A minus B. Output the result in cyan(8).
record.program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (nonzero-cells grid) (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))) (grid-positions grid))) (define (component-grid obj) (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj)) (h (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))) (w (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))) (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w 0))) ((p (in-list (obj-cells obj)))) (set-cell out (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)) (obj-color obj))))) (define (crop-nonzero grid) (let ((cells (nonzero-cells grid))) (if (empty? cells) (list (list 0)) (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))) (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))))) (define (paste-crop grid shape top left) (for*/fold ((out grid)) ((r (in-range (rows shape))) (c (in-range (cols shape)))) (let ((v (at shape r c)) (rr (+ top r)) (cc (+ left c))) (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows out) (cols out))) (set-cell out rr cc v) out)))) (define (normalize-pair a b) (let* ((aa (crop-nonzero a)) (bb (crop-nonzero b)) (h (max (rows aa) (rows bb))) (w (max (cols aa) (cols bb)))) (list (pad-grid aa h w) (pad-grid bb h w)))) (define (shape-boolean a b op color) (let* ((pair (normalize-pair a b)) (aa (first pair)) (bb (second pair)) (raw (grid-from-fn (rows aa) (cols aa) (lambda (r c) (let* ((av (not (= (at aa r c) 0))) (bv (not (= (at bb r c) 0))) (keep (cond ((equal? op 'union) (or av bv)) ((equal? op 'intersection) (and av bv)) ((equal? op 'xor) (not (equal? av bv))) ((equal? op 'a-minus-b) (and av (not bv))) ((equal? op 'b-minus-a) (and bv (not av))) (else #f)))) (if keep color 0)))))) (crop-nonzero raw))) (let* ((key (at g 0 0)) (temp (set-cell g 0 0 0)) (comps (sort (objects temp 0) (lambda (a b) (if (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))) (a (component-grid (first comps))) (b (component-grid (second comps))) (op (cond ((= key 1) 'union) ((= key 2) 'intersection) ((= key 3) 'xor) (else 'a-minus-b)))) (shape-boolean a b op 8))))
